score_settings_desc: Turn each part of the business score on or off and set how much it counts. Changes apply from the next run.
master_switch_desc: Recalculate every approved business at 03:00 Israel time. Manual runs still work when this is off.
signals_desc: Weights are relative: signals that are off or have no data yet are left out and the rest are scaled up to 100%.
factors_desc: Extra inputs inside a signal. Turning one off removes it without changing the signal weights.
recalculate_confirm: Recalculate and overwrite every business score now?
weights_must_be_positive: Turn on at least one signal with a weight above 0
not_scored_yet: This business hasn't been scored yet. Scores are calculated every night for approved businesses.
signal_sales_desc: Completed revenue and orders, recent ones count more
signal_rating_desc: Google Maps rating and review count, pulled toward the platform average until there are enough reviews
signal_localImpact_desc: Pickups, visits and spending at neighbouring businesses
signal_reliability_desc: Cancel/refund rate and days to fulfil
signal_catalog_desc: Live products and events (10 = full score)
signal_content_desc: Images, alt text, languages, profile, delivery options
signal_engagement_desc: Views on each website (compared with other businesses there), card click-through, views that turn into orders, and selling across sites
factor_momentum_desc: Last 30 days of revenue vs the 90 days before (Sales)
factor_newBusinessBoost_desc: Small bonus that fades over the first days after approval
factor_spillover_desc: Visitors who also bought nearby in the same authority (Local impact)
factor_tripHub_desc: Businesses that share the most customers with others (Local impact)
factor_giftPurchases_desc: Share of orders bought as gifts (Loyalty)
factor_refundRate_desc: Refunds after payment count like cancellations (Reliability)
factor_socialPresence_desc: Social media links on the profile (Content quality)
factor_audienceFit_desc: Group types and accessibility tags (Content quality)
param_minRatedBusinesses: Min. businesses with a Google rating
flag_LOW_SAMPLE: Few orders - score may move a lot
state_ended: Schedule ended: no more automatic runs
mode_automatic_desc: Scores are recalculated on the schedule below. You can still recalculate by hand at any time.
mode_manual_desc: Scores change only when someone clicks Recalculate now, or Recalculate on a business.
parameters_desc: Turning a parameter off removes the limit or feature it controls.
param_halfLifeDays_desc: An order this many days old counts half as much
param_halfLifeDays_off: Off: every order counts the same, however old
param_lookbackDays_desc: Only orders from this many days back are used
param_lookbackDays_off: Off: all order history is used
param_spilloverWindowDays_desc: Purchases this close together count as one visit to the area
param_hubWindowDays_desc: Purchases this close together link two businesses in the trip hub
param_hubWindowDays_off: Off: trip hub is not counted
param_newBusinessBoost_desc: Extra score for a newly approved business (0.1 = +10%)
param_newBusinessBoostDays_desc: The boost fades to zero over this many days
param_minRatedBusinesses_desc: Google rating counts once this many businesses have one
param_minRatedBusinesses_off: Off: Google rating counts as soon as one business has one
param_ratingPrior_desc: Few reviews are pulled toward the platform average, as if this many average reviews were added
param_ratingPrior_off: Off: the Google rating is used as it is
param_lowSampleOrders_desc: Fewer orders than this shows a 'few orders' note
param_maxGoogleRatingAgeDays_desc: Ignore Google ratings not refreshed for this many days (Google allows up to 30)
param_maxGoogleRatingAgeDays_off: Off: Google ratings of any age are used
save_and_recalculate_confirm: Save your changes, then recalculate and overwrite every business score now?
unsaved_changes_hint: You have unsaved changes. Save them, or they are lost when you leave this page.
factor_deliveryCoverage_desc: How many areas it delivers to; nationwide counts fully
factor_valueForMoney_desc: A good rating at a below-category price counts more
factor_stockAccuracy_desc: Share of limited-stock products that aren't sold out
factor_vendorSetupTime_desc: Days from sign-up to the first live listing (a week or less is best)
factor_policyFlags_desc: Each open warning lowers reliability by 25%; a suspension sets it to zero
factor_localSourcing_desc: Checked share of local products and local staff: up to +10%
factor_chatResponse_desc: How fast the owner answers admin messages (2 hours or less is best)
factor_eventFillRate_desc: Seats booked out of capacity, and booked guests who came
factor_qrCheckins_desc: Tickets and session bookings scanned on site
factor_tripParticipation_desc: Published trips that stop at the business or its events
factor_multiSiteReach_desc: Sites it sold on out of the sites it is listed on
score_inputs_desc: Warnings and local sourcing details. Each change recalculates this business's score straight away.
policy_flags_desc: Each open warning lowers reliability by 25%. A suspension sets reliability to zero until it is resolved.
reason_required: Write a reason of at least 3 characters
local_sourcing_desc: The business owner enters these. They count in the score only after an admin checks them, and any change needs a new check.
ga_import_desc: Views and card clicks from every website with a GA4 property ID in Website Config. Imported every night at 02:30; the score uses the saved data.
ga_import_failed_sites: Could not read GA4 for: {{sites}}. Check the property ID and that our service account has access.
ga_import_missing_sites: No GA4 property ID set for: {{sites}}
factor_siteViews_desc: GA4 page views, ranked against the other businesses on the same website
factor_listClickThrough_desc: Clicks on its cards out of the times they were shown (needs the new site events)
raise_desc: Personal suggestions from your latest score, biggest gain first.
raise_none: Nice work: nothing big left to fix. Keep selling and keep your listings up to date.
raise_note: Points are estimates out of 800, based on the current settings. Changes show after the next score update.
tip_add_photos: Add at least 3 photos to each product and event, set a main photo, and add a caption or alt text
tip_add_languages: Add your name and descriptions in Hebrew, Arabic and English
tip_add_social_links: Add your Instagram and Facebook links
tip_add_audience_tags: Add the groups you suit (families, couples, groups) and your accessibility features
tip_add_delivery_areas: Add more delivery areas (now {{areas}}; 5 or nationwide is best)
tip_add_listings: Publish {{count}} more products or events (10 is full marks)
tip_add_opening_hours: Fill in your opening hours for every day you're open, or mark "always open"
tip_first_sales: Make your first sales: share your page and mark each order completed when the customer has it
tip_grow_sales: Your sales this month are below your recent average; a promotion or new product can help
tip_more_sales: Sell more: recent completed orders count the most
tip_get_on_google: Get a Google Maps listing with the same name and address as on MetGo, and ask customers to review you
tip_more_google_reviews: Ask happy customers for Google reviews (now {{count}})
tip_improve_rating: Raise your Google rating (now {{rating}}★): reply to reviews and fix what customers mention
tip_offer_pickup: Offer pickup so customers visit you in person
tip_fill_events: Fill more seats at your events
tip_scan_tickets: Scan every guest's ticket with the QR scanner at the door
tip_join_trips: Ask the MetGo team to include you in published trips
tip_add_local_sourcing: Tell us your share of local products and your local staff in Admin inputs below (an admin checks it)
tip_resolve_suspension: Your business is suspended. Contact the MetGo team to resolve it
tip_resolve_warnings: Resolve your open admin warning(s) ({{count}}) with the MetGo team
tip_reduce_cancellations: Cut cancellations and refunds (now {{percent}}%): keep stock numbers accurate
tip_complete_orders_faster: Complete orders faster (now {{days}} days on average; 2 days or less is best)
tip_mark_orders_completed: Mark orders completed yourself as soon as the customer has them
tip_restock: Restock or update the stock of sold-out products
tip_reply_faster: Answer messages from MetGo faster (now about {{hours}} hours; 2 hours or less is best)
tip_list_on_more_sites: Ask the MetGo team about listing on more MetGo websites
tip_sell_on_all_sites: You're listed on {{sites}} websites; aim to sell on each of them
tip_get_more_views: Get more views: a strong main photo and clear name make people click your card
tip_bring_customers_back: Bring customers back: offers for returning customers and gift options
import_before_run: Import today's Google Analytics if it's missing
import_before_run_desc: Before a full run, import from GA4 only if today's import hasn't happened yet (for example, the server was down at 02:30). GA4 has nothing newer than yesterday, so repeat imports on the same day are skipped and runs read the saved data.
score_update_next_run: the score updates at the next run
local_sourcing_info: Local sourcing rewards businesses that keep money in the region. The owner enters (1) what share of the products they sell are made or grown locally, and (2) how many of their employees live in the region. Once an admin checks the numbers, they add up to 10 marks to Local impact: 60% from the local products share and 40% from local staff (5 or more = full). With default weights that's up to about 9 points out of 800. Numbers that haven't been checked don't count, and any change needs a new check.
policy_flags_info: Use a warning for a problem the business must fix, such as wrong stock or missing details. Each open warning lowers the Reliability part by 25%. Use a suspension for serious problems: it sets Reliability to zero. Resolve a warning or suspension when it's fixed; the score is recalculated right away either way.
local_products_hint: Share of what the business sells that is made or grown in the region (0–100)
local_employees_hint: Employees who live in the region (5 or more is full marks)
insights_desc: How the {{approved}} approved businesses score. {{notApproved}} businesses that aren't approved stay at 200 and aren't shown.
insights_failed: Could not load the score insights. Try again in a moment.
band_not_scored_hint: Approved, waiting for the next run
insights_limit_title: How many businesses reach a score
insights_limit_desc: Pick a score to see how many approved businesses are at or above it and how many are below.
insights_limit_bar: {{below}} below the limit, {{atOrAbove}} at or above
insights_distribution_desc: Approved businesses in each 50-point range. The dashed line is your limit.
insights_signals_desc: Average mark (0–100) across approved businesses. Low bars are where the platform has most room to grow.
insights_notes_desc: How many approved businesses carry each note on their Score tab.
insights_trend_desc: Average and median score after the last full run of each day.
insights_trend_empty: Not enough runs yet. The trend appears after two days of full runs.
insights_regions_desc: Average score of approved businesses in each DMO region.
ga_resync_days_hint: Recent days each import refreshes. GA4 keeps adjusting the last 48 hours, so 3 is a safe default (1–30).
ga_backfill_days_hint: How far back "Import now" reaches. Use more for a new website or to rebuild history (1–365).
insights_filtered: Showing: {{name}} (from the DMO / Authority picker above)
insights_authorities_desc: How many approved businesses in each authority are High, Middle or Low. The number at the end of each bar is the total; hover for the average score.
insights_dmos_desc: How many approved businesses in each DMO region are High, Middle or Low. The number at the end of each bar is the total; hover for the average score.
